item.content:encoded:
This is not a good article. Lots of expungement for no reason and just sort of a bleh thing wot etc. etc. There are plenty of interesting angles to take with comics, the treatment of women in horror, the relationship between reader and character, but it's just presented in the most flat way possible.

Also, just block out the dang title. I read EC Horror Comics reprints when I was a kid, and that's not how those comics were formatted. There were 3-4 stories in a typical issue, most with (honestly terrible) narration.

This isn't something that a normal person should know, so it's not a "gotcha." Reading this, though, it was apparent that the author had no experience with the thing they were talking about, which just took me further out of the story.

-1
